info.title: EnterpriseFlow ERP
info.description:
EnterpriseFlow ERP REST API.

**Authentication:** `POST /auth/login` returns a bearer token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Company:** users can belong to several companies. Send `X-Company-Id: <company id>` to choose one;
without it the user's default company is used. Ids of other companies always return `404`.

**Money:** amounts are returned as `{ "amount": <minor units>, "decimal": "<string>", "currency": "<ISO 4217>" }`
and accepted as decimal strings (`"1234.50"`).

**Envelope:** every response is `{ "success": bool, "data": ..., "message": string|null }`;
errors are `{ "success": false, "message": string, "errors": object }`.

post.description:
The plain token is returned only once; the database stores its hash.
Invalid credentials and inactive accounts get the same error, so the
response never reveals which accounts exist.
